qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Vertically integrated compound semiconductor (InP, GaAs, SiC) and photonics know-how provides technical differentiation, but fails empirical proof of moat. 10-year median ROIC is ~6.5% (well below the 12% hurdle). Optical transceivers face structural 10-15%+ annual ASP price erosion from hyperscaler procurement, precluding pricing power >= inflation. Long-term erosion threat from Silicon Photonics and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Vertically integrated photonics and laser manufacturing engine is structurally capital-intensive with a 10-year median ROIC of ~6.5%, well below the 12% hurdle. Datacom transceivers suffer relentless 10-15%+ annual ASP erosion demanded by hyperscaler customers. High debt load from the 2022 Coherent acquisition and negative cash flows compound cyclicality.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC of ~6.5% (FY24: 1.55%, FY25: 6.90%, FY26E: 6.7-7.7%), failing the >=12% cycle hurdle. Operating results show extreme cyclicality: FY22 revenue $3.32B (GAAP Net Income $234.8M), FY23 revenue $5.16B (Net Loss -$259.5M), FY24 revenue $4.71B (Net Loss -$156.2M), and FY25 revenue $5.81B (Net Income $49.4M, net margin <1%). Free cash flow turned negative (~-$1.0B in FY26) due to heavy capex for optical capacity expansion. Balance sheet remains encumbered with ~$3.5B+ in long-term debt from II-VI's debt-financed $7B acquisition of Coherent Inc. Intense competition in high-speed optical transceivers (800G/1.6T) from InnoLight, Eoptolink, and Lumentum, combined with hyperscaler bargaining power, ensures persistent price deflation.
